summary: Tested Payment & Tax settings for events. All 21 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI verified working - Settings tab > Payment & Tax page loads with saved values (INR, Stripe ON, Razorpay ON, GST 18%), Currency dropdown has all 10 options, Payment method toggles work, Tax Configuration shows Tax Name/Percentage when enabled, Invoice Details fields display correctly, Save Changes persists data with success toast.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend properly validates currency (10 valid options) and tax percentage (0-100 range)
Frontend correctly loads saved values from API on component mount
Tax Name and Tax Percentage fields only show when tax_enabled is true (conditional rendering)
All form fields have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: Event 1 payment_tax_settings record exists with: currency=INR, stripe_enabled=true, razorpay_enabled=true, offline_enabled=false, tax_enabled=true, tax_name=GST, tax_percentage=18, legal_entity_name='Acme Corp Pvt Ltd'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment & Tax settings fully working. Key features verified: 1) GET /api/events/1/payment-tax returns settings with global fallback if event-specific not found, 2) PUT /api/events/1/payment-tax updates settings with validation (currency, tax percentage), 3) POST /api/events/1/payment-tax/reset resets to global defaults, 4) Frontend Settings tab > Payment & Tax shows Currency dropdown (10 options: USD, EUR, GBP, INR, AUD, CAD, SGD, JPY, CHF, AED), Payment Methods toggles (Stripe, Razorpay, Offline), Tax Configuration (enable toggle, Tax Name, Tax Percentage fields when enabled), Invoice Details (Legal Entity Name, Billing Address, Tax ID), Save Changes button with success toast, 5) All CRUD operations work correctly with proper data persistence.
